name: lol-coach
description: League of Legends coach: gives Claude your Riot match history, timelines and habit analysis, plus OP.GG champion builds, runes and win rates, so it can review games and tell you what to fix.

riot_api_key.title: Riot API key
riot_api_key.description: Key from https://developer.riotgames.com (starts with RGAPI-). Development keys expire every 24 hours; update it here with /plugin configure.

riot_id.title: Your Riot ID
riot_id.description: Your in-game name and tag, like GameName#TAG.

platform.title: Server
platform.description: The server you play on: na1, euw1, eun1, kr, br1, la1, la2, oc1, jp1, tr1, ru, me1, sg2, tw2 or vn2.
